svg.title: Two namespaces with the same app ids, where one subscriber is cut off
svg.desc: At the top, a green message broker named order, with Message broker written under it, and beside it a card titled Consumer group names listing only App1 and App2. Below, a dashed region captioned Kubernetes cluster holds two dashed regions, namespace-a and namespace-b. Each holds an App1 and an App2 with Dapr sidecars, the same two app ids in both. In namespace-a, App1 publishes and App2 subscribes; in namespace-b, App1 publishes but App2 is marked with an orange cross, because it shares a consumer group with the App2 in namespace-a and receives nothing.
